verdict.rationale: First-party docs say users can describe what they want in chat and Activepieces builds the agent or automation, and that the built-in MCP server lets AI assistants build flows through natural language. Natural-language editing is documented explicitly for agents, where described changes rewrite the instructions and tools. missing for 10: explicit documentation of natural-language editing of existing flows (not just agents), in-depth docs on the in-product flow-generation experience, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can generate or edit a workflow from a natural-language prompt

citations.quote: Describe what you want in chat, and Activepieces builds the agent or automation for you.
Activepieces includes a built-in MCP server that lets AI assistants build flows, manage tables, test automations, and more — all through natural language.
describe a change in the editor — "only reply to paying customers" — and the instructions and tools are rewritten for you
